report:
Brain, right frontal lesion, stereotactic biopsy

Two smear preparations are made from the tissue. They show monomorphic cells with rounded nuclei lying against delicate branching capillaries. Sections show three pieces of tissue comprising a diffusely infiltrating glial neoplasm composed of cells with uniform rounded nuclei and perinuclear haloes set in a delicate branching capillary network. The tumour shows rounded nuclei with perinuclear haloes, a delicate branching capillary network and microcalcification. Mitoses are not identified in 10 high-power fields. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for GFAP, OLIG2 and IDH1 R132H, with ATRX retained. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 4 per cent. Molecular studies have been requested; the result will be issued in a supplementary report.

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, stereotactic biopsy - OLIGODENDROGLIOMA, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted, CNS WHO grade 2
- Histological appearance: diffuse glioma with oligodendroglial morphology, showing rounded nuclei with perinuclear haloes, a delicate branching capillary network and microcalcification
- Immunohistochemistry: GFAP positive; OLIG2 positive; IDH1 R132H positive; ATRX retained
- Molecular parameters: requested, result pending
- CNS WHO grade 2

Molecular studies have been requested; the integrated diagnosis and CNS WHO grade will be issued in a supplementary report.
